# Avali
[color=#ffa500]Warning! This species is not recommended for new players due to their extremely cold biology[/color]
Avali are an extremely cold species, and [color=#ffa500]space stations are too hot normally[/color]. So, Avali must be wearing some kind of suit that protects them from the air nearly constantly. Avali initilly spawn with a fire suit on them, though a hardsuit is also fine for this purpose.
Though, Avali have a slight buffer as their body tempature is normally 220K while their max tempataure is 280K. A normal station enviornment is around 290K
Avali deal Slash damage with their unarmed attack . They also take [color=#1e90ff]20% less Cold damage[/color] but [color=#ffa500]20% more Heat damage.[/color].
